_README: Mandatory tag policy enforced by scripts/tagging_validator.py and provider default_tags.

Project.description: Short project identifier used for chargeback and ownership.

Environment.description: dev | staging | production. Drives backup selection and access policy.

ManagedBy.description: terraform for anything in this repository; manual otherwise and flagged for import.

Owner.description: Team accountable for the resource and its cost.

CostCenter.description: Finance code used for internal chargeback.

Backup.description: Opt-in flag for the AWS Backup selection.
Backup.note: Validated as a warning: stateless resources do not need backups.

DataClass.description: internal | confidential | restricted. Drives encryption and sharing policy.

rationale: AWS does not expose a tagging API for these resource types; tagging them is impossible, not optional.
